sentences.text: In other words, it was the case of the insurer that there was a breach of the policy conditions and therefore it would not be liable to pay compensation.

It is settled law that whenever the insurer claims that there is a violation of the policy conditions, the insurer would nevertheless have to pay the compensation and thereafter proceed to recover the same from the owner of the offending vehicle, in light of the judgment in the case of Yallavva1.
4. As far as the compensation is concerned, the Tribunal has taken the notional income of the deceased at Rs.8,000/- per month notionally since there was no evidence as to the actual income.

In such circumstances, since the accident is of the year New India Assurance Co. Ltd. Vs. Yallavva and Another, ILR 2020 KAR 2239 NC: 2024:KHC:45987 2016, it would be appropriate to adopt the notional income determined by the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority, which would be Rs.9,500/-.

entities.text: New India Assurance Co. Ltd. Vs. Yallavva and Another, ILR 2020 KAR 2239 NC: 2024:KHC:45987 2016

sentences.text: Since the deceased was aged 35 years, future prospects of 40% requires to be added to the same, which makes his income to be Rs.13,300/-.
Since the deceased has five dependants, 1/4th requires to be deducted from the same, which makes his income to be Rs.9,975/-.
5. Thus, the claimants would be entitled to Rs.19,15,200/- (Rs.9,975/- X 12 X '16') towards 'loss of dependency'.

6. The claimants would also be entitled to Rs.48,400/-
each towards loss of love and affection, which would be Rs.2,42,000/- (Rs.48,400/- X 5 members).
They are also entitled to a sum of Rs.36,300/- towards miscellaneous expenses.

Thus, the claimants would be entitled to a sum of Rs.21,93,500/- as against Rs.17,83,600/- as compensation along with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. on the enhanced compensation from the date of petition till its realization.

8. The Insurance Company is directed to deposit the amount of compensation awarded within two months from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this judgment and thereafter proceed to recover the same from the owner of the offending vehicle.
9. The other aspects of the Award of the Tribunal remain undisturbed.
10. This appeal is, accordingly, allowed in part.
